done_when: The worker brief and the review that Forge ships state both rules, and the review reports a symptom-only fix or test-gaming code as a finding; new repos get them at init and existing repos on sync
why: Forge's shipped worker brief and review miss two rules that catch real defects: fix a bug at its root cause where every caller goes through, not only the path the ticket names; and never write code that only passes the tests (hard-coded expected values, test-only branches, silent defaults that hide a broken rule)
